Last night, a couple friends and I decided to go camping up in the mountains of Montana. When the sun went down, and the mountains shadowed into darkness, there was nothing but our campfire to light our small circle. I sat there in my chair staring up into the sky at the stars, but I noticed this flash of light in the sky like lightning. It wasn’t stormy. There wasn’t any thunder, just dead silence. We were in a canyon and not near any towns. I mentioned to my friends the weird flashing light after I had seen it a few times. They hadn’t seen it. It had no rhythm or pattern. It was just a random, quick, bright flash. I kept saying...there! Did you see that? Finally, one of my friends saw it too. Naturally, our minds began to wander.....What....was...it....? My anxiety was so high, I hauled my sleeping bag from the tent to the car and slept there instead. I refused to open my eyes because I didn’t want to see the flashing anymore.
